tA NO: 1 OF 2025  Petition under Section 151 of CPC is filed praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased to direct the respondents not to enter into the land to an extent of Ac.0.0650 cents covered by Sy.No.297/3A, 3A1 and an extent of Ac.0.1050 cents in Sy.No.297/3A, 3A1C1 situated at-Muppavaram Revenue Village, J.Pangalur Mandal, Bapatia District, AP without following the procedure laid down under the provisions as contained under Sec. 3A, AB,
3C, 3D, 3E, 3F, 3G and 3H of National Highway Authorities Act, 1956,
Pending disposal of WP 34976 of 2025, on the file of the High Court.

The Petition coming on for hearing, upon perusing the Petition and the affidavit filed in support thereof and upon hearing the arguments of SRI SUDHAKARA RAO AMBATI Advocate for the Petitioner, and of ADITIONAL SOLICITOR GENERAL OF INDIA, for the Respondent No.1 and of SRI S.S.VARMA, Standing Counsel for the Respondent No.2, and of GP FOR  LAND ACQUISITION, for the Respondent Nos.3 to 7, the Court made the  following  ORDER:
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned counsel for the respondents.
The contention of the petitioner is that the respondents, without issuing any notification pertaining to Ac.0.03 cents, have acquired the total extent of Ac.0.20 cents in the subject property.

In reply to the same the learned Standing Counsel appearing for the respondents submits that the respondents have taken possession only the land covered under the notification issued under Section 3A of National Highways Act and that, except for the said land, the respondents have neither taken possession nor interfered with any other land.
